response.sql: WITH overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) as overall_mean FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL), station_avgs AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_mean FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), above_average_stations AS (SELECT sa.station_mean, sa.station_mean - oa.overall_mean as above_avg FROM station_avgs sa CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa WHERE sa.station_mean > oa.overall_mean) SELECT AVG(station_mean) as mean_bandwidth_usage, AVG(above_avg) as average_how_far_above FROM above_average_stations;
